APIs for constructing a Firedancer topology and configuring tiles.

# Purpose
This header declares the API used to build and configure a Firedancer topology. It includes [`fd_topo_initialize`](<#fd_topo_initialize>), which fills `config->topo` with a full validator configuration, and a set of helper functions such as [`setup_topo_banks`](<#setup_topo_banks>), [`setup_topo_funk`](<#setup_topo_funk>), [`setup_topo_progcache`](<#setup_topo_progcache>), [`setup_topo_store`](<#setup_topo_store>), and [`setup_topo_txncache`](<#setup_topo_txncache>) that add specific topology objects to a `fd_topo_t`. It also declares [`fd_topo_configure_tile`](<#fd_topo_configure_tile>), which applies configuration data to a `fd_topo_tile_t`. The file contains function prototypes only and serves as the public interface for topology construction in the application.
